English සිංහල தமிழ் Fact Checked All Economy Society Environment Politics Health Methodology About Us Explore Fact-Checking Contact Us #false The Largest Fish Found in Thambuththegama Said to Be an AI Creation False A photo with a note stating that the largest and heaviest fish ever found was discovered in a drain used for waste disposal in the town of Thambuththegama has been circulating on social media. by Anonymous | July 29, 2024 Given the rapid spread of comments and exchanges about this, Factseeker undertook the responsibility to look into the matter. The investigation checked whether such news had been reported by major media outlets and whether there were any reports of such an incident in the Thambuththegama area. It was confirmed that no such reports existed. Further investigation into whether this image was created using artificial intelligence revealed that it was indeed an AI-generated photo. As a result, Factseeker confirms that the image of the largest and heaviest fish, purportedly found in a waste-disposal drain in Thambuththegama, was created using artificial intelligence. We are an independent fact-checking team affiliated with the Sri Lanka Press Institute(SLPI). The objective and long-term goal of the FactSeeker is to provide the public with reliable and verified content in the attempt of debunking mis/disinformation. The unit, with the SLPI, is committed to contributing to improved media literacy in Sri Lanka.
